INSERT INTO mingle_subscriptions ( id, user_id, product_id, payment_id, status, start_date, end_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{paymentId}, 'ACTIVE', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_subscriptions SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = SYSDATE, end_date = GREATEST(SYSDATE, start_date + 1/1440) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') AND SYSDATE BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pr.tier, pr.name AS productName, s.status, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate, pr.price, pr.duration_days AS durationDays FROM mingle_subscriptions s JOIN mingle_products pr ON pr.id = s.product_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') AND SYSDATE BETWEEN s.start_date AND s.end_date ORDER BY CASE pr.tier WHEN 'PLATINUM' THEN 0 WHEN 'GOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.end_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT p.product_name AS productName, p.amount, p.status, p.paid_at AS paidAt, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate FROM mingle_payments p JOIN mingle_subscriptions s ON s.payment_id = p.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC
